newsitem.title: GERMANY: Retailer Karstadt confident for full 1997.
newsitem.headline: Retailer Karstadt confident for full 1997.

text.p: German retailer Karstadt AG said on Thursday that it was confident for growth in full-year 1997, based on developments in the first quarter.
Karstadt said that group net profit fell to 58.6 million marks ($33.9 million) from 109 million marks, while net profits at the parent company fell to 114 million marks from 189.2 million marks.
The group said it was proposing a dividend of 10 marks per share for 1996, down from 13 marks a share the previous year.
Karstadt announced previously that its 1996 group sales fell slightly to 26.9 million marks from 26.98 million marks. ($ = 1.728 German Marks)
